headline: CHAOS 🪦 COFFINS ⚰️ and CLAUDIAPATRA 👑 Steal the SHOW 🎭 in Celebrity Traitors
text:
PARANOIA 😟 CONFUSION 🌀 and a BATTLE ⚔️ to SURVIVE 🏃‍♂️ among the celebrities as they FIGHT 🥊 for their LIVES 💀 in this WILD 🐺 opening episode of Celebrity Traitors series TWO 🥈!! One person may have DOMINATED 👑 much of the drama but host CLAUDIA 🧛 WINKLEMAN's gothic ARRIVAL 🚪 still caused a MASSIVE 🍆 STIR 🥄 when she was CARRIED 🛡️ aloft by DRUIDS 🌳 in a CLOSED ⚰️ COFFIN 🪦 right into a CHURCH ⛪ to greet TWENTY ONE 😱 anxious looking celebs 🎥!! "That was quite the NAP 😴" she PURRED 🐱 as she EMERGED 🌅 from her wooden BED 🛏️ leaving everyone GASPING 😮!!

"CLAUDIAPATRA 👸" gasped MODEL 📸 and actress JERRY 🦒 HALL spotting the similarities in both GRANDEUR 🏰 and HAIRSTYLES 💇 between Claudia and CLEOPATRA 🐍 the Egyptian QUEEN 👑!! Winkleman confessed at the PRESS 📢 launch she LOVED ❤️ her ICONIC 🚪 entrance but admitted she'd initially wanted to HIDE 🙈 in the castle's SUIT 🛡️ of ARMOUR 🏋️!! "It's like a sort of GCSE 📚 history FANTASY 🧚 it was either that or the GRANDFATHER ⏰ CLOCK 🕰️" she giggled while the celebs were left THIRSTY 🥵 for more of her ENTRANCE 🍑!!

But the MAIN 🏆 talking POINT 📍 of this show was actor RICHARD 🧔 E GRANT with his SHOCKING ⚡ admission after he and presenter MAYA 🌴 JAMA were selected as TWO ✌️ of Winkleman's three TRAITORS 🕵️!! Immediately afterwards Grant appeared to FORGET 🤔 the entire POINT 🎯 of the game by GLEEFULLY 😆 blurting out to those around him he was actually a TRAITOR 🐍!! You could have heard a PIN 📍 drop after he said it followed by STUNNED 🤐 SILENCE 🤫 that lasted an ETERNITY ⏳!! "It's an interesting ANGLE 📐" laughed singer JAMES 🎤 BLUNT just afterwards while comic ROB 🤖 BECKETT told him "I think you've just done something that's never happened in the game it is a BOLD 💪 strategy" leaving the whole CHURCH ⛪ in absolute CHAOS 🌪️!!

Grant later admitted in footage for viewers of the show "That may be the biggest MISTAKE ❌ I have ever made in my life I was so THRILLED 😍 to have been chosen as a traitor that in my UNGUARDED 🛡️ excitement I said 'Of course I'm a traitor'"!! He clearly needs to DEFUSE 💣 all the HEAT 🔥 that's coming in his direction after this EPIC 🤯 blunder that has everyone calling him the LORD 👑 OF CHAOS 🌪️ now!! Ex BBC journalist AMOL 📰 RAJAN swooped the following day asking Grant "What happened last night" but instead of sowing clever SEEDS 🌱 of doubt Grant said he'd been so BLATANT 😬 about wanting to be a traitor that he simply responded he WAS one when asked leaving everyone FLUSTERED 😵‍💫 and confused!!

Jerry Hall stayed LOYAL 🫡 saying "I just don't believe Richard's a traitor I've known him THIRTY 3️⃣0️⃣ years and he's my NEIGHBOUR 🏠"!! She thinks he says and does ECCENTRIC 🤪 things he's an amazing guy but is just acting out because he's not been chosen yet her loyalty might get TESTED 🧪 soon especially after remembering how Alan Carr MURDERED 🔪 Paloma Faith in series one by touching her FACE 😷!! Miranda Hart also thinks Grant could be a FAITHFUL 🙏 but admitted she is totally CONFUSED 🌀 while Winkleman told the press launch she thought Grant blurted it out in ERROR ❌ because he was so THRILLED 🥳 to be a traitor "He was GIDDY 🥴 wasn't he He's just laughing at what's happening Fantastic" she said with a wink 😜!!

Meanwhile the other celebrities also proved their WORTH 💎 on the show not least HARD MAN 💪 ROSS 🦸 KEMP the former EastEnders actor turned documentary maker whose programmes have focused on GANGS 👥 and the armed FORCES 🪖!! Having admitted how NERVOUS 😬 he was in the pews of the church he came into his own for the TASK 📋 along with ex army captain JAMES 🎸 BLUNT as they divided the celebs into TEAMS 👥 leading them to successfully find the TREASURE 🏴‍☠️ on the pirate ship bagging FIFTEEN THOUSAND 💷 pounds!! But Kemp quickly CRUMBLED 🥐 back in the castle when paranoia set in after Bella Ramsey playfully planted a captain's HAT 🎩 on his head and Leigh Anne from Little Mix touched him on the ARM 💪 making him fear he'd been KILLED ☠️ by a traitor which had Ed Gamble laughing his head off at the variety of men living within the Ross Kemp SPHERE 🌍!!
